items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the interviewer's statement that 'his nephew is playing in one of them. His name is John Robichaud too.' There is no evidence of a personal relationship between the interviewee and John Robichaud.

ctx.x: I want to be young man.
No, John went out. No, they never did dance. I used to buckle skates in the skate park. Yeah.
Did they dance and slow drag here? Yeah.
